step_by_step_procedure: Fold test: Line of symmetry causes two mirror halves to overlap.
Rotation test: Count matching orientations in 360° turn (Order n).
formulas_and_identities: Regular n-gon: n lines of symmetry, Order n
sub_branches.example_problem: Square (n=4): 4 lines of symmetry, Smallest rotational angle = 90°.
